{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Metal Snake''' (辛巳, ''kanoto mi''; onyomi ''shinshi'') is the 18th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 18th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Horse|ja|壬午}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): xīnsì

** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoto-mi
*** On'yomi: shinshi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): sinhsa (신사)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Tân Tỵ

==Months of Yin Metal Snake==
In the Gregorian calendar, during years ending in 0 or 5 (where the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kō (庚)}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu (乙)}}), the fourth month (April) is the Kanotomi month. Note that this can refer to the month in the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}} or the “solar term” month (from {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}} to the day before {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Bōshu}}).

==Days of Yin Metal Snake==
A Kanotomi day is associated with the following selection day (選日).

=== Auspicious Days ===
On a Kanotomi day, it is the fourth day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土#小土|lt_ja=小土|lt=Shōdo|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Small Earth|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
